description: Manage combat encounters in the active Novel — encounter turn order, participants, and lifecycle, not per-entity conditions. damage resolves a weapon hit against an entity or NPC health stat with a transparent roll, applying the ruleset's zero-health condition. Mutating actions persist to the Novel and are audited; status does not mutate state. Revert the most recent mutation with manage_history (action: undo). init's seed only reorders the danger set; participants keep their given order. Use when: starting, advancing, ending a fight, changing its participants, or resolving damage. Do NOT use when: applying a status effect — use manage_condition (action: apply).

action.description: init, advance, end, add_participant, remove_participant, damage, or status.

amount.description: Flat non-negative damage modifier; with no dice, the whole damage (damage).

attacker_id.description: Entity or NPC identifier dealing the damage (damage).

damage_type.description: Free-text damage type recorded in the audit entry (damage).

dice.description: Damage dice notation without a modifier, e.g. 1d8 (damage).

outcome.description: Optional text describing how combat ended (end).

target_id.description: Entity or NPC identifier to damage (damage).

weapon.description: Weapon name reported in the result and audit entry (damage).

name: manage_combat

status.description: Machine-readable result status: OK, NEED_INPUT, WARNING, PARTIAL, or ERROR; an error's Appendix O.2 category rides in `category` (REQ-002, REQ-548c).

text.description: Human-readable text envelope mirroring the structured result (REQ-001, REQ-548a).

title: Combat Encounter Management
